stem: Which sentences best belong in a summary of the section “A Necessary Invention”?

options.text: Hunters traveled long distances through harsh, snowy conditions.
People today use sunglasses when they are in bright sunlight.
Sunlight that is reflected off the snow can make it difficult to see.
Some snow goggles were made of materials such as fur and leather.
Ancient snow goggles have been found in several Arctic regions.
